metadata.scope: The data states the loy mind map's mission behaviours require. Every row points at an EXISTING seeder and @td() alias — nothing here is seeded by a new mechanism.
metadata.known_limit: One requirement stands for a per-case family: data.loy.customer.fresh-account names MSN_E2E_USER_001 as its representative alias; each 083d case binds its own MSN_E2E_USER_<case> account of the same shape.

requirements.purpose: The store has loyalty and missions switched on — the ambient state every mission behaviour reads.
The same store with only the missions switch turned off.

acquisition.transition: store settings GET-merge-PUT of Loyalty.Missions.Enable=false, read back before the next step

cleanup.via: the case's Cleanup column restores Loyalty.Missions.Enable=true

requirements.discriminates: The switch is the ONLY difference from the enabled baseline, so an empty loyaltyMissionProgress or an unaccrued order is attributable to the gate.
requirements.limits: Store-level shared state: the flip hides missions for every concurrent run on the store — never schedule beside 083c/083d.

evidence.note: the setting is read at the write path, the read path and route registration

requirements.purpose: Long-lived missions, one per goal type, for cases that assert a mission's DEFINITION.
requirements.shared_state: The definition is shared; its PROGRESS accumulates across runs and freezes at Completed, so no case may assert progress movement on it.
requirements.discriminates: One mission per goal type, so the three goal types are distinguishable on one read.

evidence.note: header: why the stable set exists separately from the per-run set

requirements.purpose: A Draft sibling of the Published fixtures.
requirements.shared_state: Publishing it is one-way (Draft → Published), so a case that publishes it consumes it for every later run.
requirements.discriminates: Differs from the Published fixtures only in status, so publish and draft-exclusion are decidable.
requirements.limits: A publish case must mint its own Draft — this fixture only answers read-side questions repeatably.

requirements.purpose: A Published mission whose window has ended and that nobody has progress on.
requirements.shared_state: Any order against it would create progress and change which branch it exercises.
requirements.discriminates: Published but out of window with no prior progress — separates window exclusion from status filtering.

requirements.purpose: A Published mission restricted to one customer group.
requirements.shared_state: Definition only — visibility is asserted, never progress.
requirements.discriminates: Read by a member and an outsider of the SAME group: one must see it and one must not.

requirements.purpose: An account inside the targeted group.
requirements.shared_state: A long-lived account whose balance and progress drift — assert visibility only.
requirements.discriminates: Differs from the outsider ONLY in group membership.

requirements.purpose: An authenticated account outside the targeted group.
requirements.shared_state: A long-lived account — assert visibility only.
requirements.discriminates: Differs from the member ONLY in group membership.

requirements.purpose: A Published mission flagged public=false.
requirements.discriminates: Identical to a public sibling except the flag, so the flag's effect (or its absence) is observable.

requirements.purpose: A mission minted this run, so no account has progress on it.

cleanup.via: seed:missions-e2e:teardown — AGENT-TEST-MSN-E2E- prefix sweep with an age floor

requirements.discriminates: Every account starts at 0% on it, so 'progress advances' is observable; a stable mission may already be Completed and frozen, which makes the same assertion undecidable.

evidence.note: header: THE ONE SHAPE THAT IS REPEATABLE
a mission with progress can be neither edited nor deleted — a fresh mission is the only way forward

requirements.purpose: A per-run OrderValueGoal whose target sits strictly between the order's merchandise value and its total.

constraints.goal_target: > the order's merchandise value AND <= the order's total

requirements.discriminates: Only a target between the two readings separates 'accrues order.Total' from 'accrues merchandise' — BL-LOY-016 §Verify.

requirements.purpose: A per-run OrderValueGoal whose target the undiscounted total would clear and the discounted total does not.

constraints.goal_target: <= the undiscounted total AND > the discounted total

relationships.note: the target is computed against this coupon's effect

requirements.discriminates: Straddles the discount: completing it would prove progress ignores the discount; not completing proves it is net of discount.

evidence.note: accepted consequence: a discount moves the customer away from the goal

requirements.purpose: An active percentage coupon.
requirements.shared_state: A shared coupon — assert its effect on this order only, never its usage count.
requirements.discriminates: Large enough to move the order total across the discount-boundary target.

requirements.purpose: A per-case account with no orders against this run's missions.
requirements.discriminates: Bound to one case, so the progress read on it is attributable to that case's own orders.
requirements.limits: Representative alias only — each case binds its own MSN_E2E_USER_<case> (see metadata.known_limit).

requirements.purpose: An account whose loyalty balance is below the mission reward.
requirements.discriminates: The grant at least doubles the balance, so 'the points spent came from the mission' is arithmetic; on a ~964M-PTS account a 500-PTS reward is not legible.
requirements.limits: The balance CLIMBS on every completion — re-checked each run, never provisioned once.

requirements.purpose: A cash-priced product that can always be bought.
requirements.shared_state: Carries no per-user state, so sharing it across runs costs nothing.
requirements.discriminates: Never out of stock, so no accrual case can be BLOCKED by inventory instead of answered.

evidence.note: header: WHAT IS RUN-SCOPED AND WHAT IS NOT

requirements.purpose: A product priced in the loyalty currency — the thing a reward is spent on.
requirements.discriminates: Buying it spends points, not cash — the only purchase that proves a reward is spendable.

requirements.purpose: The order placed by the case account against a fresh mission.

source.field: order number from the confirmation page

requirements.discriminates: Its own total is the expected currentValue, so contribution is checked against a number the case produced.

requirements.purpose: The contributing order after it completed a mission, now cancelled.

acquisition.transition: set Order.Status to the Cancelled dictionary value (BL-ORD-009 — never bind to isCancelled)

cleanup.via: none possible on the order itself; the per-run account isolates it and seed:missions-e2e:teardown sweeps its missions

requirements.discriminates: Cancelling THE order that completed the mission is what makes 'the grant is reversed' decidable — any other order's cancellation says nothing.

requirements.purpose: The points-history row a completed mission wrote.
requirements.discriminates: Landing on a zero-balance account, the spendable balance equals the reward exactly.

profiles.purpose: Read missions with the switch off.
One group-targeted mission read by a member and an outsider.
Two orders against a fresh target-2 OrderCountGoal: accrues, completes once, grants once.
One order whose merchandise misses the target and whose total clears it.
One discounted order straddling the target.
Earn a mission reward on a zero-balance account, then spend it on a points-priced product.
Complete a mission with one order, then cancel that order.
